Title: The Muster
FlavorText: War drums sound across the frontier. Muster a population of 8 to answer the call.
VictoryText: The muster is complete. Your banners stand ready.

Title: The First Lesson
FlavorText: A new ruler must learn the fundamentals before commanding armies. Complete each lesson below to prove your kingdom's foundations are strong.
VictoryText: You have mastered the fundamentals. Your kingdom is ready to grow.
DefeatText: The lessons went unlearned. Try again when you are ready.
